title: PolloSaldo prices dataset
description: Contract for data/prices.json. Written by the scraper, consumed by the web calculator. The scraper MUST validate its output against this schema before writing; CI MUST validate data/prices.json against it.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Bump on breaking changes.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful scrape run (ISO 8601, UTC).

prices.description: Latest known price per restaurant+product. One entry per pair, no history (history lives in git).

restaurant.description: Canonical polleria identifiers. Add new ones only via a spec change.

product.description: Canonical product slugs shared across restaurants so the calculator can compare.

productName.description: Product name as displayed on the source site (for provenance).

price.description: Unit price as a decimal number, never a string.

scrapedAt.description: When this price was scraped (ISO 8601, UTC).

sourceUrl.description: Exact page the price was extracted from.
